attribution: Standard disagreement-triggered executable-continuation rollout, a strengthened baseline; not a claim of a new OR algorithm.
sign_convention: Actual comparison gain = fixed baseline loss minus rollout loss; positive is beneficial. Conditional gate intervals instead use nominal-action minus combined-action loss; negative favors nominal.

control_timing_scope_by_root.scope: Conservative upper bound including common data preparation

timing_scope: The matched control CPU comparison starts before model construction and includes menu/message setup, both cheap scores, all conditional sampling and simulated continuations, actual decisions, posterior updates and trace. Full-pipeline totals additionally include common data loading and graph preparation. The preserved root28 pilot has only the full-pipeline timer, used as a conservative control-cost upper bound; the other 71 roots have the exact matching scope. A separate 71-root timing sensitivity is provided. Gate costs are already included in root costs, not added twice.
limitations: The finite-bank missing-outcome interval is not a population confidence or regret certificate.
All selected roots and all conditional worlds remain represented, including unresolved outcomes.
CPU is charged in logical-clock replay; computation does not delay a physical decision.
The original six controls and preceding four-state 128-world reference results remain unchanged.
